notes: Page presents the Nordyne serial system under the AirBloc-Nordyne heading; parent stated as Nortek (formerly Nordyne Manufacturing). Page lists related Nordyne-family brands (Ambirad, Benson, Broan, Frigidaire, Gibson, Intertherm, Kelvinator, Manmouth, Maytag, Miller, Nordyne, Nutone, Philco, Reznor, Tappan, Ventrol, Westinghouse) but does not state they share this system, so no sister is claimed and no usesStylesOf is set; styles are transcribed from this page in full. Page Style 2 (F3891 4228) is HELD, NOT SHIPPED: its year description (3rd & 4th digits) is genuinely ambiguous between overall-character counting (89 -> 1989) and numeric-digit counting (91 -> 1991, the reading corroborated by the repo Nordyne file's 16-character style where the same digit run decodes as week 38 / year 91); the page diagrams NORDYNE-2.jpg and NORDYNE-2a-Serial_Model-Data.jpg must be read before either year ships. Page Styles 3, 4 (first listing) and 5 (second listing headed Style 4) collapse to one normalized style: dash/space placement differs but normalization strips both, leaving the same 12-character shape and the same year/month positions; all three page examples are kept as examples of the merged style.

styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based, counting all characters). Same serial, positions and decode as the repo Nordyne style-1, corroborating this reading.

styles.era: 12-character serials, letter-digit-letter + 9 digits (page Styles 3, 4 and 5 merged under normalization)
styles.notes: Page Style 3 example G6R9905-05028 (year 4th-5th, month 6th-7th); page Style 4 example M 1 G 9807 - 05432 (same positions); page Style 5 (second Style 4 heading) example E2E-9705 01234 (year 5th-6th, month 7th-8th counting the dash, which is exactly positions [3,5]/[5,7] once the dash is stripped). All three normalize to the same shape with the same date positions, so one style carries all three examples.
